name: ffp-trigonometry
source:
Print Sin(1)
Degree
Print Sin(90)
Print Cos(90)
Print Tan(90)
Radian
Print Sin(1048576)
Print Cos(1048576)
Print Tan(0)

encoding.notes: Explicit Print=0x0476, Sin=0x0702, Cos=0x070c, Tan=0x0716, Degree=0x06ca, Radian=0x06be, integer=0x003e and parentheses=0x0074/0x007c opcodes. Independent of the production token table/encoder; the command offsets were derived from the original C_Tk records.

evidence.notes: Preserved circular CORDIC computes sine/cosine together and tangent through FFP division. AMOS FFAngle divides degrees by 180 then multiplies by stored Pi. The excessive-input path returns after doubling D7's low byte without restoring it, despite the source prologue describing unchanged input; at 2^20 this decodes to -2^-23. Expectations follow the instruction path and AMOS's unchecked math return flags, not captured execution. Equivalence to the selected Kickstart mathtrans library remains unverified.
